description.zh: 数据库类型。仅支持传入“Redis”或不传本参数。
description.en: The database engine of the instance. Only Redis is supported.

description.zh:
实例所属的地域ID。
> 该参数不影响查询结果，配置任意地域即可
description.en:
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

> This parameter does not affect the query results. You can specify any region ID.

title.zh: 查询服务关联角色授权

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口可查询本账号下名称为AliyunServiceRoleForKvstore的关联角色是否已经授权给云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）使用。更多信息，请参见[云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）服务关联角色](~~184337~~)。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to query whether the service-lined role AliyunServiceRoleForKvstore is created for Tair (Redis OSS-compatible). For more information, see [Service-linked role of Tair (Redis OSS-compatible)](~~184337~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-service-linked-role-exists --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine Redis --region cn-hangzhou
